name: Cherry Costello
source:
As the owner of a single-proprietor business, Cherry is a standout individual—there's nothing she does by halves. She runs the Maraschino Pit with pride, a popular watering hole for all sorts of folks both up-and-up and down-and-out. Her frank demeanor and foul mouth has a tendency to intimidate, but she refuses to smooth her rough edges just to make other people comfortable. Those that make it into her good graces are treated to her boundless affection and a soft touch underneath all that pint-sized bravado.

Trust is a difficult thing for Cherry. Hard to gain and harder still to salvage once lost. Her primary motivation is making sure that Gilda is able to protect herself and her heart, even if it means doling out some tough love in the process.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/campnellas/status/1674101402618953738]Twitter[/url]]
